name: Nils
source:
A mysterious being held captive in the basement of a building just outside the Haven. Discovered by Magda, they now seem to have some business with her.

[spoiler]An angel who once wanted to save humanity. God warned them that humans are dangerous and would hurt them, but they believed humans couldn't really be so bad and left the heavens anyway.[/spoiler]
